parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(changes, '{}'::jsonb) AS changes FROM strategy WHERE active = true ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH top5 AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.track, p.title, p.image_url, p.product_url, p.offer_url,
         p.price_min, p.price_max, p.commission_rate, p.commission_amt,
         p.sales, p.rating_star, p.shop_name, p.score
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.status = 'new'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM scripts s
      WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status NOT IN ('dropped','failed')
    )
    AND (
      (p.track = 'id' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scripts sc WHERE sc.track='id' AND sc.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) < $1)
      OR
      (p.track = 'en' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scripts sc WHERE sc.track='en' AND sc.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) < $2)
    )
  ORDER BY p.score DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT id, track, title, image_url, product_url, offer_url,
       price_min, price_max, commission_rate, commission_amt,
       sales, rating_star, shop_name
FROM top5
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE products SET status = 'used', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO scripts (product_id, track, language, voice, title, hook, scenes_json, caption, ai_score, ai_verdict, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10::jsonb, 'pending') RETURNING id;

UPDATE scripts SET status = 'dropped', error = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2;
UPDATE scripts SET status = 'failed', error = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('keyword', s.keyword, 'source', s.source)), '[]'::json) AS trends FROM (SELECT keyword, source FROM trends ORDER BY captured_at DESC, rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) s;
